title: Welcome to the Study
body: This tool lets you explore a high-dimensional Pareto frontier of dietary plans. Each solution is nutritionally optimal, meaning improving one nutrient objective always comes at the cost of another. Your goal is to navigate these trade-offs. Tutorial (~5 min)  →  Tasks (20–25 min)  →  Questionnaire (1–2 min) A reminder will appear once 5 minutes of the tutorial have passed. You can pause the timer at any time by clicking the pause button in the top right corner. During the tasks you will use either the full dashboard with all visualisation features, or a reduced benchmark version with a limited chart set. DISCLAIMER: All data in this study is entirely synthetic and should not be taken as dietary advice.
